question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Colossal
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 (Immense).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Colossal** "means extremely large or great in size. (अतिविशाल, वृहत्‍काय, बहुत बड़ा)

 
 
• **Example**: *The **colossal**__ statue of Buddha in Thailand has many visitors.*
 
 
 
• **Immense** is a synonym for **colossal.**
 
• It means extremely large or vast. (अत्‍यधिक, असीम, अपार)
 __
 
• **Example**: *This place is an **immense**__ tourist attraction.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Joyous)** means feeling or expressing great happiness or joy. (आनंदमय; ख़ुश; हर्षपूर्ण)
 
• **Option 3 (Entertaining)** means providing amusement or enjoyment. (रोचक और मनोरंजक)
 
• **Option 4 (Fantastic)** means extraordinarily good or attractive. (बहुत अच्‍छा; उत्‍कृष्‍ट)

38:Td23,
